races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: DOCTOR STEINBERG looked a top-class prospect when demolishing 7 rivals in a Grade 1 novice hurdle last season and, though things did not go to plan afterwards, is likely to prove hard to beat now switched to fences. The highly promising Court Compliance is feared most, while Fort Dino is also respected after an encouraging chase debut. DOCTOR STEINBERG (IRE) COURT COMPLIANCE (IRE) FORT DINO (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Doctor Steinberg (2/5), Court Compliance (9/2), Stede Bonnet (7/1), Franciscan Rock (9/1), Fort Dino (18/1), Walks In June (28/1), Fire Coral (50/1), Farnahoe Rebel (125/1)

races.display_title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict: IAMAGETAWAY showed improved form to get off the mark over fences at Downpatrick 41 days ago and looks capable of defying an 8 lb rise back in handicap company. Hees Dynamite is well handicapped on his hurdling form and is feared most, while That's About Right and Doctor Confusion are also respected. IAMAGETAWAY (IRE) HEES DYNAMITE (IRE) THAT'S ABOUT RIGHT (IRE)

races.display_title: Racing Again On The 26th November Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: LICEO has knocked firmly at the door since returning from a short break, again finding only one too good over C&D last week and there appears no reason why he won't make a bold bid again from an unchanged mark. Max Meridius shaped well when a place behind the selection that day and can lay down a serious challenge if consenting to race more efficiently, whilst Phoenix Arizona is another worth a look operating from a lower hurdles mark. LICEO (FR) MAX MERIDIUS (IRE) PHOENIX ARIZONA (IRE)

races.display_title: All-Weather Championships Season XIV Fleur De Lys Fillies' Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: Last year's heroine SKY SAFARI enhanced her fine record on speed-favouring all-weather tracks when landing the Winter Derby here back in February. Lightly raced and better than form figures would suggest thereafter, this has likely been her target again and James Fanshawe's mare rates a big player again. Kon Tiki (2-2 on all-weather) will find this more suitable than her Group 1 assignment latest and is feared, with improving 3-y-o Enchanted Queen also making the shortlist up in class. SKY SAFARI KON TIKI ENCHANTED QUEEN

races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: It could be worth chancing WE NEVER STOP , who often keeps better company and may be rekindled by the return to all-weather. Starmade is the obvious threat back at this venue after his encouraging third at Wolverhampton, with Lorna B another to consider having proved she's still on the upgrade after her comeback win last month. WE NEVER STOP (IRE) STARMADE (IRE) LORNA B (IRE)

races.verdict: REAL JACK wasted no time getting back on track when runner-up at Musselburgh last time and, having gone close on his previous start at this venue, he could be ready to open his account. Forever Twenty has run well over this C&D on 2 of her last 3 outings and is feared most, with Liquid Cooled another to consider. REAL JACK FOREVER TWENTY LIQUID COOLED (IRE)
